_note: KSPCB 'F-register' = the district/Regional-Office register of consented industries (Water/Air Act consent), as on 31-03-2019. Published as scanned PDFs. Used for the Arkavathi-basin industrial-register accountability layer (per-taluk counts on the Gaps layer + basin denominator in the PRS Industrial tab). Counts are OCR-extracted and approximate. See scripts/build_fregister.py.

Peenya.note: Vrishabhavathi valley - the basin's industrial core

Bommanahalli.note: SE Bengaluru -> K&C valley / Dakshina Pinakini, NOT Arkavathi - excluded

Yelahanka.note: N Bengaluru - straddles Arkavathi vs Pennar - excluded pending clean split

kabini_stretch._note: KSPCB Regional Office Mysore-2, used for the Kabini polluted stretch (Nanjangud taluk). A DIFFERENT edition and format from the Arkavathi registers above: this one carries a real text layer with explicit Taluk/Colour/Status columns, so counts are read rather than OCR-guessed. Read by scripts/build_kabini_fregister.py, which also documents why the PDF's later pages (a bio-medical-waste register) must not be counted.
